run_channel_connectivity_tests: run the ChannelTest unittest suite to verify gRPC cygrpc channel connectivity behavior
test_single_channel_connectivity: test single channel connectivity by creating a cygrpc Channel and looping through check and watch connectivity states
test_parallel_channel_connectivity: test multiple channels in parallel by spawning threads that each create loop and destroy a cygrpc Channel
test_negative_deadline_connectivity: test that a negative deadline on watch_connectivity_state does not trigger SIGABRT in cygrpc Channel
review_cygrpc_channel_api: review the cygrpc Channel API usage patterns for check_connectivity_state watch_connectivity_state and close methods
